France is struggling to contain its biggest student protests in decades. What started as a demonstration in support of striking teachers at a suburban high school to the north of Paris has snowballed into a national crisis.

Hundreds of schools have been forced to close and more than 6,000 people have been taken into police custody over the past few weeks, most of them minors with no previous criminal records. description:
Support from naturalized immigrant and Latino voters helped Donald Trump win the White House in 2024. But since then, that support has collapsed. As CNN chief data analyst Harry Enten points out, Trump's net approval rating among immigrant voters has plunged 44 points in less than two years: "That's a shift. . .away from the President of the United States amongst a group that he did historically well with for a Republican presidential candidate."

Also, a new NBC/Telemundo poll released Sunday finds that Latino voters have deeply soured on Trump and the GOP, particularly on crucial economic issues. Mike Madrid, author of "The Latino Century," and CNN senior political commentator Ana Navarro look at the sharp decline in Latino support for Trump since the 2024 election.

description:
As President Donald Trump arrived in Nebraska Monday night, to a state he won by 20 points two years ago, he is looking for a safe harbor – and to fire up friendly faces – in the latest stop on his red-state October blitz. 

In a weeklong stretch, the president’s travels from Texas to Oklahoma to Alabama to Ohio to Nebraska and back to Texas — all states he carried by double digits — underscore the degree to which Republicans are on defense as he urgently rallies supporters to come to his party’s aid. 

“This is a five-alarm fire,” a GOP member of Congress from a state Trump visited recently told CNN, asking to not be identified to avoid alienating the White House. 

Trump also said Americans should cast their ballot using “every appropriate tool,” in a pre-recorded video imploring Republicans to vote in the midterm elections, including using methods that he has historically opposed like early and mail voting. 

CNN’s Jeff Zeleny reports from Trump’s rally in Grand Isle, Nebraska. And
title: '5-alarm fire' for Trump ahead of midterms: GOP lawmaker

description:
A 28-year-old lab researcher at a Russian institute dedicated to studying plague and dangerous pathogens died of pneumonia of an “unknown” origin. The Irkutsk Research Anti-Plague Institute operates in Siberia, where several other people are quarantined. Rospotrebnadzor, the Russian agency that oversees infectious disease, has downplayed the link between the researcher’s death and her work, but the case has prompted questions about the type of plague that causes pneumonia.

Pneumonic plague is a rare, deadly lung infection caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis. Scientists consider pneumonic plague the most dangerous form of the infection. CNN speaks to medical experts on the researchers death and if there should be greater concern.
